cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a weaving studio — a tall wooden loom, shelves of dyed yarn spools, a spinning wheel and a table of woven cloth
cuts.scene: she is a weaver perched on a stool, untangling threads on the side table beside the loom
cuts.outfit: a weaver look fitted to her body — a fitted linen smock with a short hem over a halter top and shorts, bare shoulders and legs, a pin cushion on her wrist
